Satellite name Ut ProSat-1 (VSCP-1B)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher Firefly Alpha, (Elytra), (ELaNa 42)
Organisation Virginia Tech
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country US
Oneliner

Deploy a bistable coiled tape spring in a controlled, reliable, and repeatable manner on a SmallSat.
Description

Mission objectives:

  1. Leverage experience to fly a successful mission.
  2. Demonstrate effectiveness of avionics core architecture.
  3. Meet all science objectives from VT ThickSat at a minimum.
  4. Use 3U platform to fly other small experiments.
Notes

Initially thought to be on Cygnus NG-19 flight, but was not.
